Simulate a case/control single-cell study with sample-specific soup.

Source: R/simulate_study.R
simulate_ambient_study.Rd

Simulate a case/control single-cell study with sample-specific soup.

Usage

simulate_ambient_study(
  n_per = 6,
  G = 1000,
  n_cells = 700,
  rho_ctrl = 0.05,
  rho_dis = 0.12,
  bcv = 0.25,
  n_de_rare = 40,
  fc_rare = 2,
  n_de_abund = 80,
  fc_abund = 3,
  frac = c(A = 0.55, B = 0.2, C = 0.15, R = 0.1),
  n_empty = 2000,
  n_shared = 0,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

n_per

samples per condition.

G

genes.

n_cells

cells per sample.

rho_ctrl, rho_dis

mean contamination in control / disease samples (disease tissue is often more fragile).

bcv

biological coefficient of variation between samples.

n_de_rare, fc_rare

true disease genes in the rare type and their fold.

n_de_abund, fc_abund

disease genes in the abundant type A (all chosen among genes the rare type does not express).

frac

cell-type proportions; must include types "A" and "R".

n_empty

empty droplets per sample.

n_shared

genes that are genuinely disease genes in BOTH A and R.

seed

RNG seed.

Value

list: X (genes x cells), label, sample, cond (per sample), empties (list per sample), de_rare, de_abund (leak-only genes), shared, rho_true (per sample), prof.
